proposals.evidence: DEDR2598 explicitly gives Gondi sīānā give and hiyānā/hī-/ī- dialect forms. These simple hiy-/siy-/ī- survey give responses retain the documented stem variation and ordinary imperative endings; reduplicated or auxiliary-looking sīsi- sequences await fuller morphology. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
